summary: The selection efficiency is treated as cancelling in the He/p ratio ('same selection for both species'), but it is measured from separate per-species control samples, so its uncertainty is dropped from the ratio covariance.
code_change: ratio_block(): the selection blocks of numerator and denominator are left out of the relative covariance.
description_change: measurement spec: ratio cancellation selection_efficiency now treatment 'cancels', correlation model 'same selection algorithm applied to both species'.
